video.title: AI欧腐《与龙王子相缚/Bound to the Dragon Prince》
video.desc:
这平台简介都很长 记得拉到最后
Hitman Ethan Cole expects to die when a mission sends him over a mountain cliff. Instead, he is caught in midair by Rowan Ashford—a dragon prince Ethan unknowingly saved twenty years ago. Rowan should take him home, heal his wounds, and disappear. Neither of them does. Forced into an uneasy seven-day arrangement, the guarded assassin and the stubborn prince slowly learn how to live beside each other: no locked doors, no following without permission, no hidden injuries, and no touching without asking. But Ethan’s stolen records reveal something far more dangerous. Missing dragons are being captured, priced, and sold as living cargo—and Rowan’s search for his people has placed him directly in the hunters’ path. As secret missions become shared ones and old debts turn into something neither man can dismiss, Rowan risks exposing his true form to keep Ethan alive. Ethan has spent his life believing survival means needing no one. Then a dragon prince keeps choosing to stay. And somewhere in the dark, a collector has just discovered exactly what Rowan is.
杀手 Ethan Cole 在一次任务中坠下山崖，以为自己必死无疑。可他却在半空中被人接住了——Rowan Ashford，一位龙王子，二十年前曾被 Ethan 在不知情的情况下救过一命。
Rowan 本该把他送回家，治好他的伤，然后消失。可两人谁都没有这么做。
一纸勉为其难的七日之约，让戒备森严的杀手与固执的王子慢慢学着如何与对方共处：不锁门，不经允许不跟踪，不隐瞒伤口，不经同意不触碰。
然而 Ethan 偷来的档案揭露了更危险的事：失踪的龙族正在被捕获、标价，当作活体货物贩卖——而 Rowan 寻找族人的举动，恰好把他送进了猎龙者的猎枪口。
当各自的秘密任务变成共同的任务，当旧日恩情变成谁也无法再否认的东西，Rowan 不惜暴露真身，只为让 Ethan 活下去。
Ethan 这一生都相信，活下去就意味着不需要任何人。可偏偏有一位龙王子，一次又一次选择留下。
而黑暗深处，一个收藏家刚刚弄清了 Rowan 究竟是什么。
